name: dsh-plugin-coding-delegate
description: Repo-native cryptographic attestation and anti-self-approval governance for autonomous AI coding agents. A preventive control for DeepSeek Harness: the cloud planner cannot author code and every delegation leaves a hashable verdict; sandboxed local execution with hash-bound promotion, and Ed25519 dual-signed records kept in the repository's own Git notes.
comment: This root manifest exists so DSH plugin DIRECTORY discovery can find the plugin: registries read dsh.bundle from the repository ROOT package.json, and the real manifest lives at plugin/package.json and is unchanged. The path is relative with no '..' and no leading slash, per the discovery contract. Nothing installs from here: the published artefact is plugin/, and DSH loads it via a profile bundle.

scripts.gate: node scripts/check-file-hygiene.cjs && node scripts/check-contract-fixtures.cjs && node scripts/check-contracts.cjs && node scripts/verify-delegation-ledger.cjs && node --test tests/attest-unit-lifecycle.test.cjs
